en: A black‑and‑white postcard photograph showing an empty football (soccer) stadium named Lövåsvallen in Billingsfors. The image captures the pitch from one corner, with a dirt running track and simple metal railings around the field. On the right side is a small wooden grandstand with a sharply angled roof. Beyond the field there is dense forest, and in the far background a lake and low hills under a cloudy sky. Printed caption text appears along the bottom edge of the image.
